answer: The canyon report shows the merge explicitly at each karst. Each collapsed cluster gets one garden weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, an copycat who spins up 299 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 157 times the capital for one share. A farm of 2016 identities would post 886 proofs and burn roughly 37 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
